lines.arrive: The desert. You and your camel have been walking since dawn, and the water ran out hours ago.
lines.mirage: It was a mirage. Only hot air, bending the blue of the sky down onto the sand.
lines.ask: But there's a rock, just here.
lines.water: And under the rock: water. Your camel drinks. There was water here all along.
lines.end: You believed there was water here, and there was. But what you saw was a mirage, not the water. Did you know it was here?
lines.back_1: You give up on it, and lead your camel back.
lines.back_idle: You rest a while, then lead your camel back.
lines.back_2: You'll never know it. But you were right. There was water here, under a rock, a step away.
